description: Site shape: every layout and shared section (`sections`: fragments/* by name, with page count, whether the file exists and staged-change flag), whether a layout is missing, redirects count, menus grouped by where they show, and collections with their page placements. Use for 'is my layout missing', 'which shared sections exist and where', 'where does this menu show' — without listing every page. Read-only; indexing mirrors list_pages (a freshly imported/graduated site may still be indexing).
name: get_site_outline
